prompt: What was state of the schools regarding integration in the hometown of Miller Williams when he began his master's degree in Zoology?
answer: When Miller Williams began his master’s degree in zoology—around **1951**—the schools in his hometown of **Hoxie, Arkansas, were still segregated**. Hoxie did not begin integrating its public schools until **1955**, when it became one of the first Arkansas school districts to do so after *Brown v. Board of Education*.
